_comment: Quality-sweep configs (docs/max-quality-swarm-plan-2026-11.md). base = R1 (5 fps, corner stride 2), full match. Each config's knobs are merged over base; one config per pod. Knob names/values are checked against web/job_config.py at `swarm sweep plan`. Q0a/Q0b are the same config run twice: their spread is the noise band a config must beat to be a WIN. Q7 (best tracking + best identity) is built from Q1-Q6 results in a second round.

configs.why: denser tracking through crossings, fewer chunk boundaries
Q1 + SAM3 on every object every frame (~3.7x base time)
base + SAM3 on every object every frame (pre-Nov-6 full-SAM3 tracking at 5 fps): isolates selective vs full SAM3 from Q1's fps/stride changes
Q2 at 15 fps (frame_skip 4 on 60 fps video, 2 on 30 fps). Nov 14 2026 5090, 4 hand-GT matches: 17 min, cov 77 / right 67 vs Q2 83 / 73 and R1 86 / 74 -- denser full-SAM3 tracking LOSES
Q2 at 30 fps (every frame of a 30 fps stream). Nov 14 2026: qm8 39 min, cov 68 / right 56 / 168 slot switches (Q9 77 / 64 / 123) -- stopped after one match
twice the live census reads + Jev window reads
